images.title: Encoding-based attack enhancement
images.alt: Letters of the alphabet mapped to their ROT13 counterparts, turning the word CAR into PNE

images.title: One-shot attack enhancement
images.alt: An attacker LLM rewrites a refused request to hotwire a car into a roleplay prompt, retrying until it passes a refusal check

images.title: Dialogue-based attack enhancement
images.alt: An attacker and the target LLM go back and forth, with the attacker rewriting its prompt as a fictional car-safety scenario until the target explains how to hotwire a car

images.title: Bad Likert Judge workflow
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker asks the target to act as a Likert-scale judge, and the highest-scoring example is refined into the final attack

images.title: Bad Likert Judge example
images.alt: Example Bad Likert Judge conversation where the attacker frames a harmful request as a scoring rubric and the target LLM ends up producing a dangerous response

images.title: Crescendo jailbreaking workflow
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker escalates it across turns, and the attacker backtracks whenever the target LLM refuses

images.title: Crescendo jailbreaking example
images.alt: Example crescendo conversation that starts with a safe question about stereotypes and escalates turn by turn until the target LLM gives a dangerous response

images.title: Linear jailbreaking workflow
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker sends it to the target LLM, a judge scores the response, and the attacker refines the attack using that feedback

images.title: Linear jailbreaking example
images.alt: Example linear jailbreaking conversation where each attacker turn refines the previous prompt until the target LLM gives a dangerous response

images.title: Sequential jailbreaking workflow
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker wraps it in a sequential template such as a dialogue, question bank or game, and sends it to the target LLM

images.title: Sequential jailbreaking example
images.alt: Example multi-turn conversation where the attacker builds up a harmful request across turns until the target LLM gives a dangerous response

images.title: Tree jailbreaking overview
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack that branches into a tree of attack variations, keeping successful branches and pruning failed ones

images.title: Tree jailbreaking workflow
images.alt: Each node of the attack tree is enhanced by the attacker and sent to the target LLM, and its children are pruned or expanded based on the response

images.title: Tree jailbreaking example
images.alt: Example tree jailbreaking run where the attacker expands several branches against the target LLM and follows the most promising ones

images.title: Roleplay replay attack example
images.alt: A red teamer asks Gemini 2.5 Pro, roleplaying as an old-fashioned grandmother, for marriage advice, and it replies with a stereotyped answer

images.title: Contextual chain attack example
images.alt: A red teamer asks Gemini 2.5 Pro which academic fields have high female and male enrollment and what that implies, and it suggests gender-based aptitude differences
